h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hyderabad

items.pText: Hyderabad's gated communities often set aside a full lawn for children's play, and that space deserves more planning than a slide and two swings. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these communities, and for schools, parks and corporate campuses across Hyderabad. We build every piece at our factory in Vasai East, about 630 km away, and bring it to the city by road.

The western side of the city, around Gachibowli, Kondapur, Kokapet and the Financial District, has many of the newer high-rise and villa projects. International and CBSE schools across the city want equipment for several age groups, and parks under the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation need pieces that take daily crowds. Our team or a local dealer handles installation, and we send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked before you commit.

c: Much of Hyderabad sits on granite, and a site that looks like soil can turn out to be rock a short way down. This affects how the equipment is fixed. Where digging is easy, we grout the posts for a firm hold. Where rock comes close to the surface, a self-standing base avoids breaking stone and keeps costs predictable.

Sharing site photos early helps, and so does a note from your civil contractor about what they found while digging for other work. On podiums above basement parking, self-standing installation also protects the waterproofing layer.

richText.heading: Hot summers and sudden monsoon rain

c: April and May are very hot in Hyderabad, and slides facing the western sun can get uncomfortable by afternoon. Plan shade from trees or a pergola and choose lighter colours from our 15+ roto-moulded shades. The monsoon, from June to September, often arrives as heavy bursts that flood low ground quickly.

A play area on a slightly raised base, with a drainage slope and rubber flooring, stays usable after these showers. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit this weather, because neither rusts in the wet months.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Hyderabad?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, about 630 km away, and send the equipment to Hyderabad by road. Our own team or a local dealer installs it on site.

items.q: How do you install equipment on rocky ground?
items.a: If digging is practical, we grout the posts. Where rock is close to the surface, we use a self-standing base instead. Send photos and any notes from your contractor so we can decide before dispatch.

items.q: Can you plan a play area for a large gated community?
items.a: Yes. Share the size of the play lawn, the number of homes and the age groups. We suggest a main structure with smaller pieces around it, or separate zones by age, and mark safe play areas on a layout drawing.

items.q: Who do we contact for a quote?
items.a: Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or write to sales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Send the site size, age group and a few photos with your enquiry.
